articles.title: Choosing the right steel plate for your application
articles.excerpt: Consider the grade, thickness, dimensions and operating environment alongside your project specifications. Structural and fabrication work may require different properties. Review material documentation and consult the responsible engineer before ordering.

articles.title: Selecting fittings and flanges for your piping system
articles.excerpt: Fittings and flanges must match the dimensions, materials and standards of your piping system. Check the fluid, temperature, pressure and connection type against the system specifications. Our team can help confirm product information and source materials to your requirements.
